mapper.select: SELECT c.client_id, c.email, c.cash_balance, c.password_hash, c.address, c.phone_number, c.ssn, c.clientstatus_id, cs.clientstatus_name FROM clients c LEFT JOIN client_status cs ON c.clientstatus_id = cs.clientstatus_id WHERE c.client_id = #{id}

SELECT c.client_id, c.email, c.cash_balance, c.password_hash, c.address, c.phone_number, c.ssn, c.clientstatus_id, cs.clientstatus_name FROM clients c LEFT JOIN client_status cs ON c.clientstatus_id = cs.clientstatus_id WHERE c.email = #{email}

SELECT c.client_id, c.email, c.cash_balance, c.password_hash, c.address, c.phone_number, c.ssn, c.clientstatus_id, cs.clientstatus_name FROM clients c LEFT JOIN client_status cs ON c.clientstatus_id = cs.clientstatus_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clients (email, cash_balance, password_hash, address, phone_number, ssn, clientstatus_id) VALUES (#{email}, #{cashBalance}, #{passwordHash}, #{address}, #{phoneNumber}, #{ssn}, #{clientStatus.id})
mapper.update: UPDATE clients SET email = #{email}, cash_balance = #{cashBalance}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, address = #{address}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, ssn = #{ssn}, clientstatus_id = #{clientStatus.id} WHERE client_id = #{id}
